Name: Robin HD Portraits by Hemptress
Author: Hemptress
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This portrait makeover gives Robin flowing copper curls, bright green eyes, soft freckles, full lips, and a gorgeous curvy silhouette in a semi-realistic style.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Portraiture[/b] using versions compatible with your game.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and unzip this portrait pack.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Inside[/color]

[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/[/code][color=#D4D4D8], create a folder named[/color]

[code]Hemptress Robin[/code][color=#D4D4D8].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the portrait PNGs directly inside that folder with these filenames:[/color][/*]
[/list][table][tr][th][color=#D4D4D8]Portrait set[/color][/th]
[th][color=#D4D4D8]Filename[/color][/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]Everyday[/color][/td]
[td][code]Robin.png[/code][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]Beach[/color][/td]
[td][code]Robin_IslandSouth.png[/code][/td]
[/tr]
[/table][list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Talk to Robin and press [b]P[/b] while her dialogue box is open until this portrait set appears.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Your everyday portrait’s location should be:[/color]

[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/Hemptress Robin/Robin.png[/code]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Six everyday expressions, including her cheerful wave.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Four matching beach expressions with her signature orange swimsuit.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]A long, wavy copper ponytail and soft, feminine features.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]An orange top and fitted brown carpenter’s vest for her everyday look.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Coordinated artwork across both portrait sets.[/color]


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/*]
